_guide: Things you can do when you Stay here on a world, and the lines that tell how it went.
activities: one entry each. id (lowercase, never reused), ic (an emoji), name, desc (one line for the Stay menu),
find: the chance (0 to 1) that the session turns up a new place on the world,
souvenir: the chance it brings back a collectible,
when (optional): only offered when the world matches, written like line conditions. ground: true / false, water, temp, life go from 0 to 1.
shipTags: "telescope" in when = only offered once the ship has equipment with that tag (items.json, kind "ship").
Its story lines go in the group called act_<id> below, written like content/lines.json. {crew} is whoever went, {place} a spot on the world
(one you found, or the world's name), plus {biome}, {weather}, {time}, {world}. Try them in tools/text-preview.html.
Biomes are often plural ("rust plains"), so don't put a verb or "a" straight after {biome}: write "the ground of the {biome} dips", not "the {biome} dips".

activities.name: Wander
activities.desc: Walk somewhere nobody has been and see what's there.

activities.name: Drift
activities.desc: Let the ship drift through the clouds and see where it ends up.

activities.name: Camp
activities.desc: Set up camp, light a fire, stay up too late.

activities.name: Stargaze
activities.desc: Find a quiet spot and look up for a while.

activities.name: Fish
activities.desc: Cast a line into whatever this world has instead of water.

activities.name: Sketch
activities.desc: Draw the view, slowly, until you really see it.

activities.name: Collect samples
activities.desc: Fill a few jars with rocks, air, dirt or something stranger.

activities.name: Cook
activities.desc: Make something with what grows, swims or crawls here.

activities.name: Crew picnic
activities.desc: Everybody outside, one big blanket, too much food.

activities.name: Night at the telescope
activities.desc: Everybody takes a turn at the big telescope.

activities.name: Dance night
activities.desc: Records on, lights low, everybody dances badly.

activities.name: Tend the ship garden
activities.desc: Water, prune, repot, and plant a seed from this world.

activities.name: Read together
activities.desc: Everyone in the nook, one book, taking turns reading aloud.

activities.name: Cook a feast
activities.desc: The big stove, every pot, the whole crew at one table.

activities.name: Game night
activities.desc: Cards, dice and at least one dramatic accusation.

activities.name: Swim
activities.desc: Find some water that is safe enough and jump in.

activities.name: Climb
activities.desc: Pick the tallest thing in sight and get to the top of it.

activities.name: Nap outside
activities.desc: Lie down somewhere soft and let the world go on without you for a while.

activities.name: Write letters
activities.desc: Stay in, make tea and write to people far away.

activities.name: Watch the fish
activities.desc: Sit by the aquarium and let the slow fish do the thinking.

activities.name: Piano evening
activities.desc: Everybody plays one song on the old piano, well or not.

activities.name: Movie night
activities.desc: Hang the sheet, pick a film, argue about the film, watch a different film.

activities.name: Fix things
activities.desc: Take the broken things to the workbench and make them less broken.

activities.name: Tea ceremony
activities.desc: Slow, careful tea at the little table, and no talking about work.

activities.name: Develop photos
activities.desc: Turn the last world into prints in the red light of the darkroom.

place: A [quiet|wide|narrow|hidden] stretch of {biome}, [half in shadow|bright with {star} light|cut through by old tracks].
Here the ground of the {biome} [dips|rises|folds] into something that looks almost built on purpose.
[Wind|Silence|A low hum] fills this part of the {biome}. Nothing else seems to move.
A place where the edge of the {biome} meets something stranger, and neither seems sure who was here first.
[Rocks|Spires|Dunes|Ridges] in the {biome}, worn smooth by a very long time.

place.text: Pools of still water lie here, mirroring the sky [perfectly|almost perfectly].
Frost [lace|feathers|ferns] covers everything here, even the shadows.
The ground here is warm to the touch, and smells faintly of [smoke|metal|sulfur].
Small living things [crowd|hum|glow] in every crack here.
Clouds [pile up|swirl|part] here like a slow staircase going nowhere.
A calm patch inside the storms, where the air goes [silver|pale gold|soft blue].

act_wander: {Crew} walks out across the {biome} with no plan at all, which turns out to be a good plan.
{Crew} follows a trail that might be animal tracks, might be wind, and might be nothing.
{Crew} climbs the nearest high point to see what's on the other side. More {biome}. And then, something else.

act_wander.text: {Crew} walks until the ship is a little dot, then turns around and walks back, slowly.
{Crew} insists on taking the long way. {Crew.they} {crew:is|are} right.

act_drift: The ship drifts for hours through layers of cloud. {Crew} keeps the window open and doesn't talk much.
{Crew} cuts the engines and lets the wind take the ship. It goes somewhere it wanted to go.
Lightning flickers far below. {Crew} counts the seconds and loses count.
act_camp: {Crew} lights a fire at the edge of the {biome}. Everybody stays up later than they meant to.
The tent goes up crooked. Nobody minds. {Crew} tells a ghost story that isn't scary at all.
{Crew} falls asleep under the sky of {world} and wakes up with frost in {crew.their} hair.

act_camp.text: {Crew} makes something warm in {crew.their} {crew.gear}, and it's the best thing anyone has eaten in weeks.
{Crew}'s {crew.gear} is the only light for kilometres. It's enough.

act_stargaze: {Crew} lies back and counts the moons. Then counts them again, to be sure.
From {world}, the stars are [too many|strange|close|very far]. {Crew} picks one and gives it a name.
{Crew} points out a constellation that looks like a teapot. It definitely does.

act_stargaze.text: {Crew} looks for a long time through {crew.their} {crew.gear}, and says nothing, which says a lot.

act_fish: {Crew} casts a line into the water of {world}. Something nibbles. Something leaves.
{Crew} catches a fish with too many fins and lets it go with an apology.
No fish at all. {Crew} calls it a good day anyway, and means it.
act_sketch: {Crew} draws the {biome} with fast, scratchy lines, then slow careful ones.
{Crew}'s drawing of {place} is better than the real thing, everybody agrees. Except {crew.them}.

act_sketch.text: {Crew} fills three pages of {crew.their} {crew.gear} before the light goes.

act_samples: {Crew} fills one jar with dust, one with air, and one with something that won't stay still.
{Crew} labels every jar carefully. One label just says "???".

act_samples.text: {Crew} chips a sample from the {biome} with {crew.their} {crew.gear}.

act_cook: {Crew} cooks something with a local plant. It tastes like {world} smells.
{Crew} invents a soup. It's blue. It's good. It will never be made the same way again.

act_cook.text: {Crew} eats most of it before anyone else gets a bowl.

act_picnic: The whole crew spreads out on the {biome}. Somebody brought too much bread. Nobody complains.
{Crew} starts a game nobody quite understands, and everybody plays it anyway.
act_observe: {Crew} finds a comet nobody has charted and names it after the cook.
Through the big telescope, {world} looks close enough to touch. {Crew} keeps saying "look, look".

act_observe.text: {Crew} spots something on the far side of {world} that wasn't on any map.

act_dance: {Crew} picks the first record. It's very loud. Nobody minds.
Somebody tries a spin, somebody falls over, and {crew} laughs until {crew.they} {crew:cries|cry}.

act_dance.text: {Crew}, who never dances, dances. Nobody says a word about it, and everybody remembers.

act_garden: {Crew} plants a seed from {world} and labels it with a hopeful question mark.
{Crew} repots the tomatoes and talks them through it.

act_garden.text: {Crew} finds the first flower in the garden this morning and makes everyone come and see.

act_read: {Crew} reads the next chapter aloud and does all the voices. The villain's voice is a little too good.
Everyone falls asleep in the reading nook, one by one. {Crew} keeps reading anyway.
act_feast: {Crew} cooks everything there is. There are leftovers for three days, and nobody is sorry.
The feast on {world} goes on until late. {Crew} makes a toast to the ship, and to the people in it.
act_games: {Crew} wins, loses, and demands a rematch, in that order.
The game ends in an argument about the rules and a promise to play again tomorrow.

act_games.text: {Crew} is suspiciously good at this game.

act_swim: {Crew} jumps into the water first, shrieks at how cold it is, and then refuses to come out.
The water here is so clear the crew can see their toes, and a few small curious things looking back.
{Crew} floats on {crew.their} back and watches the {star} sky until somebody calls everyone in.
act_climb: {Crew} reaches the top first and waves down like the whole {biome} belongs to {crew.them} now.
The climb takes all session. The view from the top makes it worth every scraped knee.
Halfway up, {Crew} finds a ledge where someone else once sat and carved a little star.
act_nap: {Crew} lies down in the {biome} for five minutes and wakes up two hours later, very happy.
Everyone naps in a row, like seals. Somebody snores. Nobody minds.
{Crew} dreams about home and wakes up somewhere better.
act_letters: {Crew} writes six pages and then crosses most of it out, except the last line.
The galley is quiet except for the scratch of pens and the kettle.
{Crew} draws a little map of the ship in the margin of every letter, so people at home can find {crew.them}.
act_aquarium: {Crew} has named every fish. The fish have not been told.
One of the fish glows brighter whenever {Crew} sits down. Probably a coincidence. Probably.
The crew sits by the tank in the dark for a whole session, saying nothing at all. It is lovely.
act_piano: {Crew} plays one song with one finger, very slowly, and gets a standing ovation.
The three sticky keys turn every song into a new song. Nobody fixes them on purpose.
{Crew} plays something sad and then something silly, to make up for it.
act_movies: The film is old and the sound is wrong and everybody cries at the end anyway.
{Crew} falls asleep in the first ten minutes and claims the next day to have loved it.
Popcorn goes everywhere. {Crew} says it is part of the experience.
act_tinker: {Crew} fixes the galley clock. It now runs backwards, which {crew.they} {crew:insists|insist} was a choice.
A drawer of broken things becomes a drawer of slightly less broken things.
{Crew} takes apart a radio to fix it and builds a lamp instead. It is a very good lamp.
act_tea: The tea is poured slowly. {Crew} says it tastes of the last world. It does, a little.
Nobody talks about work. Somebody tries. They are given more tea.
{Crew} warms the cups first, the old way, and everyone feels looked after.
act_photos: A print slowly appears in the tray: {Crew}, laughing, mid-sentence, on a world already far behind.
{Crew} pegs the photos up in a long row. The darkroom fills up with the last world.
One photo comes out blurry and turns out to be everyone's favourite.
